rules.comparable_quality: Same data, version and configuration on CPU and GPU; no speedup from different workloads. B1 runs the same matrices, xgboost build, parameters and seed on both devices, reports rounds and validation log loss next to each time, and a fixed-rounds variant with identical work.
rules.full_cost: The cost per decision includes idle time in the declared operating scenario (bench.cost, versioned); development experiments stay apart.
rules.growing_loads: Several data sizes (B1), batch sizes and concurrency levels (B3), to see where the GPU adds value instead of assuming it.
rules.separate_times: Cold start, training, scoring and generation measured apart; latency p50 and p95 always with concurrency and throughput.
